newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Loewen Group starts neutral.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Loewen Group starts neutral.

text.p: -- Rodman & Renshaw Inc said Tuesday it initiated coverage of Loewen Group Inc with a neutral rating.
-- The Canadian company is the seocnd-largest deathcare provider in North America, with 947 funeral homes and 289 cemeteries in the United States and Canada, Rodman said.
-- Rodman said it believes the shares are fully valued at their current level after a 30-percent run-up following a hostile takeover bid from competitor Service Corporation International.
-- Loewen Group shares were unchanged Tuesday at 37.
